answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 25478 Country: India Title: Is it a sunnah to remove mustache or trim mutrche? Now a days many people are removing moutache. Is it against of Sunnah? Question: Is it a sunnah to remove mustache or trim mutrche? Now a days many people are removing moutache. Is it against of Sunnah? Answer ID: 25478 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1498/1498/M=1431) Both types of sayings (i.e. sunnah and bidah) are quoted concerning the shaving of moustache. حلق الشارب بدعة و قيل سنة . (درمختار). It is better to trim the moustache with scissors etc till the lip is clear. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
